# R35 exterior literature source

`truth_status=proved-standard`

This comparison was opened only after the R35 deterministic seal formed. None
of the names or formulas below was available to the discovery or application
executables.

Robert D. Horowitz, *Characters of Free Groups Represented in the
Two-Dimensional Special Linear Group*, Communications on Pure and Applied
Mathematics 25 (1972), 635--649,
[doi:10.1002/cpa.3160250602](https://doi.org/10.1002/cpa.3160250602), establishes
the polynomial trace-character setting for words in free groups. His later
paper *Induced Automorphisms on Fricke Characters of Free Groups*, Transactions
of the American Mathematical Society 208 (1975), 41--50, identifies the action
induced by free-group automorphisms on the corresponding character ring. In
this conventional vocabulary, the R35 swaps, inversion, and generator
multiplication are elementary **Nielsen** deeds and their returned coordinate
maps are induced character-ring automorphisms.

William M. Goldman, *Trace Coordinates on Fricke Spaces of Some Simple
Hyperbolic Surfaces*, Handbook of Teichmüller Theory II (2009),
[arXiv:0901.1404](https://arxiv.org/abs/0901.1404), Section 5.1, presents the
rank-three `SL(2,C)` character variety as a quadratic hypersurface in the seven
traces used by R35 and as a branched double cover of the six lower traces. This
matches the already sealed R34 sum/product fiber and supports the R35
interpretation of a zero vertical derivative as a projection-relative
**branch** face rather than, by itself, an intrinsic singularity of the entire
character variety.

Richard Brown, *Automorphisms of the Fricke Characters of Groups*,
[arXiv:math/0311119](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0311119), proves that the natural
free-group automorphism action extends to polynomial automorphisms of the
ambient trace-coordinate space and preserves a complex volume form up to
sign. The exact R35 **Jacobian** matrices are therefore the differentials of
the returned polynomial coordinate changes; their tangent-chain receipts are
the local algebraic transport expected of that standard action.

The standard comparison applies to the general matrix identities and their
polynomial differentials (`proved-standard`). The finite 1,272-state,
6,360-edge atlas, transition counts, witnesses, and held-out nine-deed
prediction remain `established-bounded`. The receiver-relative causal and
geometric reading remains `interpretation`. No arbitrary automorphism,
character variety, Hodge, or RH claim is established by this comparison.
